newsitem.title: USA: ARCO shuts gas unit at Calif refinery-trade.
newsitem.headline: ARCO shuts gas unit at Calif refinery-trade.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co lost use of a 43,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) gasoline-making unit late Wednesday at its Carson, Calif., refinery, traders said Friday, lifting wholesale gas prices one cent in West Coast markets.
"The hydrocracker is down," said a trader familiar with the refinery's operations. "It was a problem in the hydrogen plant and unit as well," he added.
No restart date had been set, the trader said.
The unit produces gasoline and a smaller volume of ultra-clean diesel fuel mandated by the state (CARB).
Wednesday's shutdown marked the first equipment problem at a key refinery this summer. The lack of shutdowns has kept production and supplies high, weakening refinery profits, traders said earlier

The wholesale price of unleaded gasoline in Los Angeles rose one cent Friday to 55.50/56.50 cents a gallon, as other refiners, anticipating more buying from Atlantic Richfield (ARCO), bought up supplies.
